{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gwendolyn 6''' was an expensive make of processor chip used in [[IT-3 Interrogator]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and developed between [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] by the company [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]]. It included [[tachyon processing bands]], [[quantum RAM]], and [[biocell storage]] and gave the IT-3 an edge over the [[ISB-120]] as its processing speed was 50.32 times greater than the ISB.
